content.rendered:
Archer Glen Picture Day will be on Tuesday, May 4th. Students attending in-person will have pictures during the school day. Online CLOUD students will have sign-ups for slots between 1:40 pm – 2:40 pm. Additional time slots will be added, if needed.

Online ordering information is available HERE along with picture information.

Picture packets were sent home in the fall. Some families ordered online at that time. We do have some paper packets available in the office. Please contact Sandi at slemmert@sherwood.k12.or.us if a paper ordering packet is needed.
